newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel - E-4 done, low sulphur quiet.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel - E-4 done, low sulphur quiet.

text.p: Low sulphur straight run fuel on Thursday saw higher sellers' offers which were met by a stony silence by potential buyers.
"We have seen offers as high as $146 fob NWE, but with one percent (cracked) coming off it just is not attractive," said one dealer who thought a more realistic level was the high $130s fob.
Two Russian E-4 cargoes were heard sold at around formula +$2 cif. Another E-4 cargo, acquiried earlier in the week, was rumoured to be available again.
